home.title: Welcome
home.empty: Your space is ready. The screens for your role will appear here.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.network: No connection. Your actions will be sent when the network is back.

codes.AUTH_TEMPORARILY_LOCKED: Too many attempts. Try again in {{minutes}} minute(s).
codes.RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Please wait a minute.
codes.EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED: Your e-mail address is not confirmed yet. Open the link you received by e-mail.
codes.LINK_INVALID_OR_EXPIRED: This link is no longer valid. Ask for a new one.
codes.PASSWORD_TOO_SHORT: The password needs at least 8 characters.

codes.PASSWORD_SAME_AS_EMAIL: The password must not be your e-mail address.
codes.ALTCHA_INVALID: The anti-robot check failed. Reload the page and try again.

codes.MEMBERSHIP_EXISTS: You already have an access, or a request, for this residence.
codes.COMMENT_TOO_LONG: The comment can have at most 500 characters.
codes.PHONE_INVALID: This mobile number is not valid.

codes.PERMISSION_DENIED: You do not have the right to do this.
codes.VERSION_CONFLICT: Someone changed this in the meantime. Reload the page.

codes.IMPORT_OUTDOOR_AREA_UNKNOWN: No outdoor area with this name.

codes.UNIT_CATEGORY_TYPE_MISMATCH: This category is for another type of unit.
codes.UNIT_LOCATION_INVALID: A building or an outdoor area, not both.

codes.ISSUE_TYPE_ARCHIVED: This type of problem is no longer offered.

invitation.intro: Choose your password for the account {{email}}. You will use it to sign in.

validation.emailInvalid: This e-mail address is not valid.
validation.passwordMismatch: The two passwords are not the same.
validation.phoneInvalid: This mobile number is not valid for this country.

password.rules: At least 8 characters. A short sentence that is easy to remember works well.

forgot.title: Forgot your password
forgot.intro: Enter your e-mail address. You will receive a link to choose a new password.
forgot.sent: If an account matches this address, an e-mail is on its way. The link is valid for one hour.

reset.title: New password
reset.done: Your password was changed. You were signed out of your devices: sign in with the new password.

verify.title: Confirm my e-mail address
verify.done: Your e-mail address is confirmed. You can sign in.
verify.intro: Enter your e-mail address to receive a new confirmation link.
verify.sent: If an account is waiting for its confirmation, an e-mail is on its way. The link is valid for 48 hours.

links.missing: Incomplete link. Open the whole link you received.

altcha.label: Anti-robot check
altcha.error: The check failed. Reload the page.
altcha.expired: The check expired. Reload the page.
altcha.failedHelp: The anti-robot check could not finish. Check your connection, then reload the page.

registration.title: Register to your residence
registration.intro: Enter the code shown under the QR code of your residence.
registration.commentHint: For example: Apartment B12, owner; parking P3.
registration.keyHint: With the key and the expected e-mail, your access is approved at once.
registration.done: We sent you an e-mail. Open the link to confirm your address: your request then reaches the manager.
registration.signInAndJoin: Sign in and join this residence

access.title: My residences
access.intro: Your accesses and your units. A pending request shows nothing until the manager approves it.
access.joinedPending: Request sent. The manager will decide.
access.joinedActive: Your key was recognized: your access is open.

keyOutcome.MATCHED_NEEDS_REVIEW: Key recognized, a unit is taken

requests.title: Access requests and residents
requests.intro: Read the comment, choose the person's units and approve, or refuse.

units.search: Find a unit by its reference
units.title: Units

import.unitsIntro: Download the template, fill one row per unit, then send it. Nothing is created if a row has an error.
import.residentsIntro: One row per planned unit. Each person receives a personal key, shown once.

outcome.CHECKED: {{total}} rows checked, no error. Untick "only check" to import.
outcome.REJECTED: Nothing was created: correct the rows below and send again.

pre.title: Pre-registrations
pre.intro: Prepare the arrival of a person with their units: they register with the QR code and their key, and are approved at once.
pre.keysOnce: These keys are shown only now. Print them or download them before leaving this page.
pre.cancelConfirm: Cancel this pre-registration? Its key will stop working.

qr.title: Registration QR code
qr.intro: Print it at the entrance: residents scan it to register.
qr.disabledNotice: Registration is closed: the code no longer works.
qr.rotateConfirm: Replace the code? The printed one will stop working at once.
qr.rotated: New code created. Print it again.
qr.printInstruction: Scan this code with your phone to register to the residence.

categories.title: Unit categories
categories.intro: The default typologies and your own categories.
categories.codeHint: Capital letters and digits, for example T6 or LARGE_SHOP.
categories.name: Name

people.title: People and roles
people.intro: Give the manager role on a residence, and choose the rights of each role. A change applies at once and is logged.

adminOrganizations.title: Organizations
adminOrganizations.intro: Client organizations, their promoteurs and support access.
adminOrganizations.name: Name
adminOrganizations.reasonHint: Mandatory: for a deactivation, and for a support access (10 characters at least, for example the ticket number).

support.title: Support sessions
support.intro: Every access to an organization's data, with its reason. Each action done meanwhile is logged with the session.
support.opened: Support access open for one hour. Go to the home page to work in this organization.
support.banner: Support access: {{organization}}, until {{until}}. Every action is logged.

adminZones.title: Provisional zones
adminZones.intro: Communes created by promoteurs: validate them with their official code, or merge them into the right commune.
adminZones.mergeConfirm: Merge? Its addresses move to the chosen commune.

texts.title: Texts of the application
texts.intro: A saved text is visible at once, without a new version. A new version never overwrites it.

templates.TICKET_STATUS_CHANGED: Ticket {{reference}} in {{siteName}} has a new step.

report.title: Report a problem
report.scanForTechnical: For a broken equipment, scan the QR code on it.
report.sentIntro: Your ticket {{reference}} has reached the residence. You will be told of each step.

routing.title: Ticket routing
routing.intro: For each type of problem: who receives new tickets and who sees them.

assets.title: Equipment
assets.name: Name
assets.importIntro: Download the template, fill one row per equipment, then check the file before importing it.
assets.qrUnknown: This QR code is not known.

circuits.title: Ticket circuits
circuits.intro: Circuits are loaded by the architect; here they are read and published.
circuits.clientIntro: A new circuit applies to new tickets; the options apply at once, to open tickets too.
